description.text: The Japanese Gym deck of Sabrina, Saffron City's Gym Leader, sold as ポケモンジム第3弾「ヤマブキシティジム ナツメ」 (Pokémon Gym 3: Yamabuki City Gym, Natsume) on 26 February 1999 with Blaine's deck, the last pair of six. Its 64 cards are 26 different ones: Sabrina's own Pokémon, Sabrina as a holo Trainer, a holo Sabrina's Alakazam, the Saffron City Gym stadium, new Trainers, and reworded copies of older Trainers that the decks share. The cards carry the Gym series' symbol, as Leader's Stadium's and Challenge from the Darkness's do, but no card number or rarity mark. Challenge from the Darkness reprinted many of them with a rarity mark, and English players got them in Gym Challenge; the deck was the model for the English Sabrina theme deck. This pair was pitched at more experienced players than the first four decks. It came with a rule book, counters and a purple Alakazam coin.
